positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - Tech Lead for Payments
positions.locationName: Fort Collins, Colorado, United States · Remote
positions.description: My team is responsible for BillPay APIs and ensuring that payments are correctly routed to the best payment rail. Starting from scratch a couple of years ago, we've built a system that has successfully scaled to pay millions of bank bill pay payments. And we're still building to make the system work even better.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Platform engineer building micro services to support Tendril's energy management platform. As a platform engineer, we build micro services written in Java and Scala which communicate using Google Protocol Buffers over Finagle. Data is stored either in Cassandra or Postgres/RDS depending on the service. REST APIs are exposed with a jax-rs or Finatra layer. Services are packaged in Docker containers which run on Amazon EC2.
* Working in a DevOps culture, I also release new service versions, identify and fix performance bottlenecks, and monitor services in production.
* Specific projects include building a REST API on top of Tendril's Building Model for external customers. All our services our tested with Cucumber BDD to verify requirements and correct implementation. 
* My current project is Tendril's Home Energy Reports project which uses MapReduce workflows (Hadoop, Pig) using data from our platform to transform utility data into paper reports and emails designed to encourage customer energy savings.
positions.insights: Skills: Code Review · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD)

positions.title: Principal Software Developer
positions.description: Developer working on the Oracle Axiom SAN and NAS storage system. Expert Java Developer who is the go to engineer for issues involving performance tuning and threading. Coordinate new feature development with teams in charge of other components and write design spec for new features.

positions.title: Founder
positions.description:
Freeheel Logic is my part time consulting/freelance company. In the past I’ve worked on a number of interesting projects including:
•	Race Log – Race management software built for a professional drag racing team, Race Log stores a history of races and uses the data to suggest car settings and predict race times. Race Log is a Java Swing application built on top of the Java Persistence API and Derby.
•	Developed a collection of NetBeans IDE plugins to support the PICBASIC programming language and PIC microcontrollers. Wrote an ANTLR grammar for PICBASIC to support syntax highlighting in the IDE.
•	Working with Davis Technologies, I developed the Traction Control Panel which is a Java Swing UI that uses Bluetooth to connect to and configure a microcontroller used to limit wheel spin in the vehicle.
•	Developed a Java ME version of the Traction Control Panel for mobile devices so the car’s mechanics could use their cell phone to configure the vehicle’s traction control device.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Java developer focusing on management software for Pillar Axiom SAN storage system. Successfully transitioned to Oracle after acquisition.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Contracted at Pillar Data Systems before being asked to join full time.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Java developer working on Activant Eclipse, an ERP solution focused on the distribution industry. Working as part of a Scrum team, our main task is to make customers’ jobs easier by implementing new features and provided mission critical support for all aspects of the system. 
•	Developed a testing framework to track application performance across releases and successfully used the framework to discover performance regressions.
•	Successfully transitioned after Activant acquired the Eclipse division from Intuit.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: Technical lead responsible for developing the web based user interface for a new print workflow product. On an aggressive schedule, our team transformed a set of ideas into a complete working product that exposed the complex workflow ideas through an easy to use, web-based interface. My team designed and implemented the web application using Apache Struts/Tiles and Ajax and deployed the product on the IBM DB2 and WebSphere.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description: •	I was a member of a small team of developers that designed and implemented a financial client-server system. I was directly responsible for the development of the client tier and was involved in a variety of tasks including: user interface design, CORBA interface development, and object-relational persistence mapping (O/R Mapping). Other responsibilities included developing a web ready reporting module based on XML and refactoring the code for increased performance.
